purpose: Estimate hosted value of adaptation and market-order position in one narrow time window while measuring same-package hosted noise/drift.

interpretation_policy.directionally_resolved: A contrast is directionally resolved only when abs(contrast) > noise_proxy. Otherwise classify it as INCONCLUSIVE, regardless of sign.
interpretation_policy.promotion: No arm may be promoted solely from this four-slot calibration. Hosted results update architecture beliefs and select the next validation target.
interpretation_policy.do_not_compare_to_old_snapshot: Do not substitute the historical R4B 143.2 score for the fresh bracket controls.

slot_5_rule.if_order_position_resolved_positive: Repeat CR011 to test whether the positive order-position signal reproduces.
slot_5_rule.if_adaptation_resolved_positive_but_orde: Repeat CR008 to test whether adaptation itself reproduces.
slot_5_rule.if_both_primary_effects_negative_or_inco: Use slot 5 only for a pre-audited orthogonal candidate justified by CR-014; otherwise repeat R4B for a third noise observation rather than inventing a variant post hoc.
